method: Read actual evaluated source triangles and actual native GLB node hierarchy. Finite independent clear-space grids and blocked structural controls compare triangle intersections with declared convex compounds. Marker metadata does not replace native transforms.

No functioning display, switching, book selection or animation is implemented.
